purpose: Design of how the eight doc-link SKILLs and two custom Agents are composed: responsibilities, per-SKILL sequences, the operating flow, and the request/result exchange with Agents.
summary: Composition table of eight SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) with kind, write targets and requirements
Two custom Agents: toc-updater generates document info (up to 3 documents per run) and query-worker performs search
Responsibilities of operation and lookup SKILLs, including DLID embedding, indexing, searching and resolving DLIDs
Responsibilities of check SKILLs, what each detects, how findings are handled, and the check-impact result structure
Use case diagram showing users, the project management AI and caller skills invoking each SKILL
Per-SKILL sequence diagrams (sections 3.1 to 3.8) for embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, the four checks and resolve-dlid
Operating flow common to introduction and later changes: check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs, check-impact, repeated after body edits
Rules for writing references with content hash in link titles using resolve-dlid
Agent data exchange table: identifiers, request, result, error value, script validation, and deletion timing for each Agent
Check SKILLs only detect and report, writing work files under .temp/doc-link, and never rewrite managed state
tasks: Implementing or modifying any doc-link SKILL.md or its scripts
Designing or changing the toc-updater or query-worker custom Agent
Defining the Agent request and result exchange and its validation
Reviewing SKILL responsibilities and write boundaries against requirements
Working on the operating flow order of check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs and check-impact
Implementing change impact notification handling with check-impact
Writing references with content hash in link titles
Updating sequence diagrams or use cases for doc-link
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
